en: A black and white postcard showing a meticulously maintained geometric garden, with palm trees, shrubs, and several potted flowers in the foreground. Several people in period dress are seen walking or sitting in the landscaped grounds. The style suggests an early-to-mid 20th century era. The postcard has text on the front reading 'Bad Pyrmont' and 'Palmengarten.' The reverse includes printed German text, a handwritten message, a postage stamp from the Deutsches Reich, and a museum advertisement.
